skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge about enterprise development and change, including concepts, factors driving and hindering change, planned change models, intervention measures, and global trends.
Understand and apply principles of managing and leading change in organizations.
Develop skills in independent work, teamwork, communication, and creative thinking.
Analyze and solve practical problems in enterprise development and change with leadership and management skills.
Develop self-study and research skills, adaptability to different work environments, and professional ethics.
Improve skills in presenting and communicating ideas effectively.
Enhance critical thinking and reflective skills in analyzing and solving problems.
Understand global trends in enterprise development and change.
